idea-plugin.name: imux
idea-plugin.description:
imux turns your JetBrains IDE into a full AI coding cockpit — run Claude Code, Codex, and pi sessions in editor tabs, and give them the power of your IDE through IDEA MCP.

Why imux instead of running AI agents in a separate terminal?

AI coding agents are powerful, but on their own they work like a programmer with only a text editor and a terminal — they can read files, write files, and run commands, but they cannot use your IDE's refactoring, debugging, inspections, or run configurations. imux bridges this gap.

IDEA MCP: give AI agents full IDE capabilities

imux automatically injects the JetBrains MCP server into every AI session it launches. This means your AI agents can:

  • Safe refactoring — rename symbols across the entire project by semantic identity, not risky text replace
  • Interactive debugging — set breakpoints, step through code, inspect variables, evaluate expressions — instead of print-debugging
  • IDE-level inspections — catch framework-specific issues (Spring, Django, ESLint, Android…) that compilers and linters miss
  • Run configurations — run tests and apps with the exact IDE settings (env vars, runtime args, working directory)
  • Database access — query databases using your IDE's saved connections and credentials
  • Code formatting — apply your project's configured Code Style, not an external formatter
  • Semantic navigation — trace call hierarchies, find symbol definitions, and understand type relationships across modules

Works with all JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, Rider, CLion…) and all languages they support. The injection is session-scoped — it does not modify your CLI's global config.

Session management in editor tabs

  • Run AI sessions in editor tabs alongside your code — split, rearrange, or move to another window
  • The AI Agents panel lists sessions for the current project, sorted by recent activity
  • Resume any session with one click — no need to look up session IDs
  • Notifications when an agent finishes a turn or needs input, with elapsed time and session title
  • Handoff between agents — continue work from Claude Code in Codex or Pi with context carried over

imux does not host your conversations. Session history stays in each CLI's own store. Uninstalling the plugin leaves all session history intact.

Requirements: Any JetBrains IDE 2026.2+ and at least one supported CLI: claude, codex, or pi.
